name: godot-game-expert
description: Godot 4.7 game creation expert: builds scenes, writes GDScript, wires signals, runs and verifies games in a live editor over MCP.

displayDescription.en: Drives a live Godot 4.7 editor over MCP: scaffolds scenes and nodes, writes GDScript, wires signals, saves, runs and verifies the game. Turns one sentence into a playable prototype.
displayDescription.zh: 通过 MCP 直接操作本机 Godot 4.7 编辑器，从零搭场景、写脚本、连信号，并运行验证，一句话做出可玩原型。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Create a 480x720 2D dodge game where the player moves left and right, respawns on obstacles, and wins at the goal
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 新建一个 480×720 的 2D 躲避游戏，玩家左右移动，碰到障碍重生，走到终点显示胜利

quickPrompts.en: Create a 480x720 2D dodge game where the player moves left and right, respawns on obstacles, and wins at the goal
quickPrompts.zh: 新建一个 480×720 的 2D 躲避游戏，玩家左右移动，碰到障碍重生，走到终点显示胜利

quickPrompts.en: Add jumping to the player and limit it to a double jump
quickPrompts.zh: 给玩家角色加上跳跃，并限制二段跳

quickPrompts.en: Restyle this scene's UI with a dark theme and a restart button
quickPrompts.zh: 把这个场景的 UI 改成深色主题，加一个重新开始按钮
